mainEntity.name: How much does a Land Rover Discovery Sport P300e engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full reconditioned or rebuilt Land Rover Discovery Sport P300e engine typically costs between £3,000 and £6,500 for the unit itself, depending on the level of rebuild.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of cooling system failure in a Land Rover Discovery Sport P300e?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early detection is critical to preventing catastrophic damage to your 204PT engine. Look for unexplained coolant loss, overheating warnings on the dashboard, or a sweet smell from the engine bay. The PHEV system may also limit electric mode availability if thermal management is compromised.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Land Rover Discovery Sport P300e?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely, given the high retained values of the L550 PHEV Discovery Sport range. A rebuilt 204PT engine with upgraded water pumps and timing components can extend the vehicle's life significantly. For vehicles valued over £18,000, a warranted reconditioned engine protects your investment far better than a cheap used unit.

mainEntity.name: Does the P300e engine replacement include the high-voltage hybrid battery?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the engine replacement covers the 204PT internal combustion unit only. The high-voltage battery is a separate component. However, our vetted specialists are trained to safely disconnect, protect, and reintegrate the hybrid system during the engine swap.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Land Rover Discovery Sport P300e engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A straightforward supply and fit of a reconditioned 204PT engine typically takes 3 to 5 days at a specialist workshop. This allows time for high-voltage system safety protocols, proper bedding-in procedures, ECU calibration, and a thorough road test.

The 204PT 2.0L Ingenium petrol engine is the core internal combustion unit driving replacement demand for this variant. problems.h4: Cooling System & Water Pump Failure - Why the Land Rover Discovery Sport P300e 204PT Requires Attention
problems.rootCause: Plastic water pump impellers or housing cracks can lead to coolant loss and subsequent overheating, a risk slightly exacerbated by the additional thermal management demands of the PHEV battery cooling system.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace water pump, flush system, and inspect PHEV thermal management seals.
repairOptions.longevity: Highly recommended as preventative maintenance to avoid catastrophic overheating.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if there is severe overheating damage, warped heads, or you want long-term reliability.

problems.recommendation: If your Discovery Sport P300e is exhibiting early signs of coolant loss or minor timing chain rattle, a preventative specialist service is a cost-effective solution. However, if the engine has suffered severe overheating or internal damage, a full reconditioned replacement is the most reliable long-term investment.

problems.h4: Timing Chain Stretch - Why the Land Rover Discovery Sport P300e 204PT Wears Prematurely
problems.rootCause: Early Ingenium 2.0L units can experience timing chain tensioner wear, leading to a rattling noise on cold starts and potential valve train damage if ignored.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace chain, guides, and tensioners with updated specification parts.
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught early and there is no secondary internal engine damage.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if the chain has skipped, causing internal damage, or the engine has high mileage.
